senses.definition: n.m. structure (loan-word = ܒܶܢܝܳܢ according to LagBN 205) applied
to enclosing wall of Ezekiel’s temple Ez 40:5;
to rear-building of same 41:12(×2), 15, but read prob. בִּנְיָה q.v.; so Sm Co;
appar. to whole temple 42:1, 10 (Co reads הבית); cf. v 5 (del. Co);—Sm refers v 1 to enclosing wall, vid. a.
